author: Codex

findings.text: The pinned Nvidia route returned exactly LAB_ROUTING_OK, with 36 input tokens, 6 output tokens, zero reported cost and no reasoning tokens. This single success supports connection compatibility only; recall, JSON formatting, multi-turn reliability and spontaneous topic choice remain unmeasured.
findings.title: Nemotron is a promising connection candidate, not yet behaviorally assessed

findings.text: HTTP 403 says the free endpoint is available only on agentic harnesses, with failed_routing_step=Gate Free Endpoints by Agentic Harness. The lab sent its ordinary direct API request. No application identity was spoofed and no access settings were changed. This is an access result, not a model failure on the instruction.
findings.title: Inkling has an application-access restriction

findings.text: The next separately budgeted batch can complete the remaining Nemotron checks and sample Ling, keeping the already observed system check as a prior observation. Preserve these closed batches and avoid retrying restricted Inkling. Liquid needs a separate reasoning-enabled condition; Gemma needs available upstream capacity. No additional inference is scheduled.
findings.title: Next assessment should prioritize Nemotron and the untouched Ling route

method: Read the complete successful reply and the complete API error; replayed request identity, cost and exact-output rule. Technical assessment, not independent human rating or semantic classification.
summary: Nemotron passed the system-instruction check and reported zero cost. Inkling rejected the next request because its free endpoint is restricted to approved agentic harnesses. The version-2 access-error rule closed this screen. Ling was not dispatched, and no self-play root began.
